It has decent health and fast speed, alongside [[Stun Immunity]] that makes it harder to stall. Upon death, it will create a purple circle which applies a 50% speed buff to any enemy in it for 10 seconds. ==Logbook Description== "''The one time the Speedy King was not quick enough was when it came to saving what was left of his kingdom. Unlike the Slow King, the Speedy King fought the Void head on. In battle, their actions could have been described as desperate as they tried to face the Void Reaver. In the wake of their defeat the flowers bloomed, and now they sprint across the same flora they once fought against.''" ==Appearance== The '''Speedy King''' has a white body with a cracked face. It wears a purple shirt, cape, black pants, a bronze crown, armbands, shoes and vest. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Juggernaut]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]], [[Kingpin]] or [[Ranger]] can be used to deal with the '''Speedy King'''. *The [[DJ Booth]]'s purple track can be useful with its [[Range Buff]], making it harder for sped up enemies to get out of a tower's range. Additionally, its ability can be used to slow them down. *Setting towers to ''Last Enemy'' can prevent '''Speedy Kings''' from reaching far enough to boost stronger enemies on certain waves. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} SpeedyKingCA.png|'''Speedy King''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ModernSpeedyKingIconIG.png|'''Speedy King''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Speedy King''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Speedy King''' added. {{Hardcore|[[Void Cultist]]|Wave 38|Speedy King|Wave 39|[[Vindicator]]|Wave 40}} {{Voidcore|[[Slow King]]|Wave 38|Speedy King|Wave 39|[[Crystalian]]|Wave 40}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
